knee-pushup: kneeling on a mat, both knees pressed into the mat, hands under shoulders, arms fully straight, body in one line from knees to head
same kneeling position, knees still pressed into the mat, elbows bent about 90 degrees, chest lowered close to the floor
incline-pushup: hands on a flat bench, feet on the floor, body straight and inclined, arms fully extended
hands still on the bench, elbows bent, chest lowered almost touching the bench edge
decline-pushup: feet resting on a bench, hands on the floor under the shoulders, arms straight, body inclined head-down
same setup, elbows bent about 90 degrees, chest lowered close to the floor
diamond-pushup: plank on hands, hands close together under the chest forming a triangle, arms straight
same narrow hand position, elbows bent and tucked close to the ribs, chest lowered near the hands
wide-pushup: plank on hands, hands placed wider than the shoulders, arms straight
same wide hands, elbows bent outward, chest lowered toward the floor
tempo-pushup: standard plank on hands, arms fully extended, body straight

scap-pushup: plank on straight locked arms, shoulder blades squeezed together, chest slightly lowered between the shoulders

pike-pushup: hands and feet on the floor, hips high in an inverted V, arms straight, head between the arms

cable-press: standing at a cable machine, handles at chest height, hands beside the chest, elbows back, one foot slightly forward
same stance, both arms extended straight forward at chest height, cables under tension

lying on the same bench, arms opened wide to the sides, dumbbells level with the chest, elbows still slightly bent
cable-fly: standing between two cable pulleys at shoulder height, arms opened wide to the sides, elbows slightly bent

bb-ohp: standing, barbell resting at collarbone height, elbows under the bar, core braced

kb-press: standing, one kettlebell racked against the forearm at shoulder height, wrist straight
standing, the same kettlebell pressed fully overhead with one arm, arm straight, torso upright
arnold-press: standing, dumbbells held in front of the shoulders, palms facing the body
standing, dumbbells pressed overhead, arms straight, palms now facing forward
band-ohp: standing on a resistance band, hands at shoulder height, elbows bent, band under the feet
standing, arms pressed fully overhead, band stretched taut from the feet
push-press: standing with dumbbells at shoulder height, knees slightly bent in a shallow dip
standing tall on straight legs, dumbbells pressed fully overhead, arms straight
band-lateral: standing on a resistance band, arms down along the sides, elbows slightly bent
standing, arms raised out to the sides to shoulder height, band stretched, elbows slightly bent
close-grip-press: lying on a bench, barbell held with hands shoulder-width, arms fully extended above the chest
lying on the same bench, elbows bent and tucked close to the ribs, barbell lowered to the lower chest
bb-curl: standing, barbell held with an underhand grip, arms straight down, elbows close to the ribs
standing, barbell curled up to chest height, elbows still pinned to the ribs, torso upright
incline-curl: seated on an inclined bench, arms hanging straight down and slightly behind the body, dumbbells in hand
seated on the same inclined bench, dumbbells curled up toward the shoulders, upper arms still hanging back

same seated position, elbow still braced on the thigh, dumbbell curled up toward the shoulder

standing, dumbbells curled to chest height with palms still facing down, wrists straight
band-curl: standing on a resistance band, arms straight down, palms forward, elbows at the ribs
standing, hands curled up to the shoulders, band stretched from under the feet
cable-curl: standing at a low cable pulley, arms straight down, elbows fixed against the torso
standing, bar curled up to chest height, elbows still fixed against the torso
skullcrusher: lying on a flat bench, dumbbells held straight above the chest, arms vertical
lying on the same bench, elbows fixed and pointing up, dumbbells lowered beside the forehead

same seated position, wrists lifted upward, palms still facing down

same standing hold seen a moment later, forearms visibly working, grip tight, posture still upright

pulled up at the top, chin level with the bar, elbows bent and pointing down
neutral-pullup: hanging from parallel neutral-grip handles, palms facing each other, arms fully straight
pulled up at the top, chin above the handles, elbows bent close to the body
inverted-row: hanging under a low bar, arms straight, body in one line, heels on the floor
pulled up under the same bar, chest close to the bar, elbows driven back, body still straight
scap-pullup: hanging from a pull-up bar, arms straight, shoulders relaxed and pushed up toward the ears

same hinged position, kettlebell pulled up to the hip, elbow driven back, torso not rotating

same position, hands pulled down to the upper chest, elbows low, shoulders down
cable-row-single: seated or standing at a cable with one handle, that arm extended forward, torso square and braced
same stance, the handle pulled to the hip, elbow driven back, torso still square without rotating
facepull: standing facing a band anchored at face height, arms extended forward holding the band
standing, hands pulled apart toward the forehead, elbows high and wide, shoulders down
facepull-cable: standing at a cable with a rope at face height, arms extended forward holding the rope ends
standing, rope pulled to the face, hands spread wide apart, elbows high

lying on the same bench, the dumbbell lowered back behind the head, arms still nearly straight
straight-arm-pulldown: standing at a high cable, arms extended forward and slightly up, torso leaning slightly forward
standing, arms swept down to the thighs, elbows still completely straight

standing, shoulders shrugged straight up toward the ears as high as possible, arms still hanging straight
bb-shrug: standing, barbell held at arm's length in front of the thighs, shoulders relaxed and low

seated lightly on the bench in the bottom squat position, shins vertical, torso upright
split-squat: standing in a split stance, one foot forward and one back, both legs straight, torso upright

bottom position, front knee bent about 90 degrees, rear knee lowered toward the floor, rear foot still on the bench

band-squat: standing tall on a resistance band with the ends held at the shoulders, legs straight
deep squat position, band stretched taut, thighs parallel to the floor, torso upright

hinged forward on that leg, torso nearly horizontal, free leg extended straight back, dumbbell hanging close to the floor

hinged at the hips, torso inclined forward, barbell lowered along the shins, back flat, hips pushed back
kb-rdl: standing tall, kettlebell held with both hands in front of the thighs
hinged at the hips, torso inclined forward, kettlebell lowered toward the shins, back flat

hinged forward at the hips, torso inclined toward horizontal, barbell still on the upper back, back flat

hinged at the hips, torso inclined forward, hips pushed back, band stretched between the legs

hips lifted into a single-leg bridge, one foot still flat, the other leg still straight, body in a line from knee to shoulder

torso raised up to a straight line with the legs, hands still at the temples, no hyperextension

leaning far forward from the knees, body straight from knees to head, hands reaching down to catch the floor

standing on the balls of both feet, heels lifted high, dumbbells still hanging at the sides

same seated position, heels lifted high onto the balls of the feet, dumbbells still on the thighs
calf-hold: standing flat-footed beside a light support, heels on the floor
standing high on the balls of both feet, heels fully lifted, holding the position, fingertips near the support

same wall stance, toes and forefeet lifted off the floor, only the heels in contact, shins working

hollow hold position, lower back pressed into the mat, arms and straight legs both lifted clear of the floor, body in a shallow banana shape

same high plank with one hand lifted off the floor touching the opposite shoulder, hips level and not rotating
plank-reach: forearm plank, both forearms on the floor, body straight from heels to head
same forearm plank with one arm extended straight forward off the floor, hips still level

side plank with the hips driven up high, body in one straight line, forearm and lower foot still the only contact

bear hold, knees hovering a few centimetres above the mat, back flat and still, hands and toes the only contact

mid-crawl, one hand and the opposite foot lifted and moving forward, hips still low and stable
leg-raise: lying flat on the back, hands under the hips, legs straight and raised vertically above the hips
lying flat, legs still straight but lowered close to the floor, lower back still pressed down
reverse-crunch: lying on the back, knees bent and stacked above the hips, hips resting on the floor
hips curled up off the floor, knees drawn toward the chest, shoulders still down
hanging-knee-raise: hanging from a pull-up bar, arms straight, legs straight and still below the body
hanging from the bar with both knees raised up toward the chest, no swinging

same seated position, torso rotated to one side, kettlebell carried past that hip, heels still down
cable-crunch: kneeling facing a high cable pulley, rope held near the forehead, torso upright
torso curled down toward the floor, spine rounded, rope still at the forehead, hips unmoved

same stance, both arms pressed straight out in front of the chest, torso resisting the pull without rotating

mid-stride walking with that single dumbbell still in one hand, torso still vertical and not leaning

mid-stride walking with the dumbbell still locked out overhead, ribs down, no back arch

balancing on one leg, the other foot lifted clear of the floor, hands free and not gripping the support

balancing on the same leg with the eyes closed, head level, support within reach but untouched
single-leg-reach: standing upright on one leg, the other foot lifted slightly behind, torso vertical
hinged forward on that standing leg, fingertips touching the floor in front, the free leg extended back, other foot still off the floor

standing in a tandem stance with one foot directly in front of the other, heel touching the toes, arms at the sides

mid-step of the heel-to-toe walk, the rear foot lifted and swinging forward to place the heel against the toes

hinged forward on that leg, torso nearly horizontal, arms still out to the sides, free leg extended straight back in line with the torso

same side-lying position, the top knee opened upward against the band, feet still together, pelvis not rolling back
hip-abduction: standing tall with a band around the ankles, feet together, one hand on a light support
standing, one leg lifted straight out to the side against the band, torso still vertical
jumping-jack: standing tall, feet together, arms down at the sides
mid jumping jack, feet apart and arms raised overhead, body at the wide position
high-knees: standing tall on both feet, arms bent at the sides, torso upright
mid-exercise with one knee driven up to hip height, the opposite arm forward, the other foot on the floor
mountain-climber: high plank on straight arms, both legs extended straight back, body in one line
same high plank with one knee driven forward toward the chest, the other leg still extended back, hips low
squat-thrust: crouched with both hands on the floor and feet close to the hands, hips low
full plank position, legs extended straight back, hands still on the floor, body in one line
burpee-nojump: standing tall with arms at the sides, feet hip-width
full plank position with hands on the floor and legs extended straight back, body in one line
burpee: standing tall with arms at the sides
plank position, hands on the floor, legs extended straight back, body in one line
skater: standing balanced on one leg after a lateral bound, the other leg crossed slightly behind, torso low
balanced on the opposite leg after the next bound, mirrored position, stable landing

mid-punch with one arm extended forward at shoulder height, elbow not locked, the other hand still guarding the chin
stair: standing at the bottom of a lit outdoor staircase, one hand near the rail, one foot on the first step
several steps higher on the same staircase, mid-climb, steady posture, hand near the rail
walk-hill: walking uphill on a steady outdoor slope, mid-stride, upright posture
further up the same slope, mid-stride, upright posture, steady pace
run-interval: running at an easy pace on an outdoor path, relaxed upright posture, mid-stride
running faster on the same path, longer stride and stronger arm drive, still controlled and not an all-out sprint
rower-interval: seated on a rowing machine at the catch, knees bent, arms extended forward toward the flywheel

box-jump-step: standing in front of a low stable bench in a shallow athletic dip, arms swung back
standing balanced on top of the same low bench, both feet fully on it, knees soft, upright posture

landing position further forward, both feet flat, knees and hips bent absorbing the landing, arms forward
split-jump: bottom of a split stance, one knee low, front knee bent, arms ready
the opposite split stance after switching legs, the other foot now forward, knees bent, landing absorbed

landed on the floor in front of the bench, both feet flat, knees and hips bent absorbing the landing, torso upright

same lunge with the inside arm rotated up toward the ceiling, chest open to the side, gaze following the raised hand
hip-90-90: seated on the floor in a 90-90 position, one shin in front and the other out to the side, both knees at right angles, torso upright leaning toward the front leg

downdog: kneeling on all fours on a mat, hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips
downward dog, hips pushed high, body in an inverted V, hands and feet on the mat, knees slightly bent

deep-squat-hold: standing tall with feet shoulder-width, a light support within reach

calf-stretch: standing facing a wall with both hands on it, feet side by side, both heels flat

doorway-chest: standing beside a doorway with one forearm flat against the frame, elbow at shoulder height, torso square

band-dislocate: standing tall holding a band wide in front of the thighs with both hands, arms straight

quad-rotation: kneeling on all fours with one hand behind the head, that elbow pointing down toward the supporting arm, back flat

neck-mob: seated upright with shoulders relaxed, head neutral and facing forward

wrist-mob: kneeling on all fours with the palms flat on the floor, fingers pointing forward, weight over the hands
